maddeler.e: الْمُحِيط الْمُتَجَمِّد الْجَنُوبِيّ • (al-muḥīṭ al-mutajammid al-janūbiyy) m
maddeler.t: From مُحِيط (muḥīṭ, “ocean”), مُتَجَمِّد (mutajammid, “frozen”), active participle of تَجَمَّدَ (tajammada, “to freeze, to be frozen”), and جَنُوبِيّ (janūbiyy, “southern”); literally "the southern frozen ocean."
